title: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: The Beach at Sunset
alt: A Piplup and a Chimchar stand on wet sand with their backs to us and watch the sun go down over the sea. Red Krabby sit on rocks at the left and blow bubbles, which drift across a rose and violet sky. A cliff in the shape of a shark's head is far off at the right.
summary: A painting of the beach from Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the beach near Treasure Town in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky, a game by Chunsoft. At sunset the Krabby come out on the rocks and blow bubbles, and the bubbles take the light of the sun.

The story starts on this beach, where one partner finds the other in the sand, and it comes back here at the end. The partners in this painting are a Piplup and a Chimchar. Sharpedo Bluff is at the right. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
